description: This file contains utility functions for string manipulation, including splitting strings within a specified range, finding the index of a query within a string, and splitting a string by a query.

methods.name: splitRangeWithinString
methods.description: Splits the input string into an array of substrings within the specified start and end indices, handling boundary checks.

methods.name: getIndexOfQueryInString
methods.description: Finds the index of a query substring within a string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: splitQueryInString
methods.description: Splits a string into parts, splitting at the position where the query is found, using other utility functions.
